result_text:
Folders whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` are now classified as mock resources (test scope), at any depth and with either path separator.

**Change:** In `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`, I replaced the two old `__mock…/` and `mock…/` conventions with one pattern, `(.*[/\\])?(__)?mock[^/\\]*[/\\].*`. The folder-name part accepts any characters except a separator, so `mock`, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe` and `mock模拟` all match. The existing `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` cases still match. `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java` and `mockery.java` do not. I left the `mockapi`, `_mock.*` and `[Mm]ocks` conventions alone.

**Test:** I added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`, which covers the cases above, including backslash paths. It passes with `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test`.

Nothing is committed.
